title: RUNZE RP42 Industrial Micro Syringe Pump - Nanjing Runze Fluid Control Equipment Co., LTD.
desc: The RUNZE RP42 is a compact industrial micro Syringe pump for precise aspiration and dispensing in analytical instruments and automated fluid systems. Available in 100, 500 and 1000 uL capacities, it supports integrated-driver and external-drive configurations for OEM equipment integration.
h1: RUNZE RP42 Industrial Micro Syringe Pump
bodyHtml:
Product Overview

The RUNZE RP42 is a compact industrial micro Syringe pump designed for precise aspiration and dispensing in analytical instruments, laboratory equipment and automated fluid systems. A stepper motor and lead-screw transmission convert rotary motion into controlled Syringe travel for stable micro-volume fluid handling.

The series is available in 100, 500 and 1000 uL capacities. Integrated-driver versions support RS-232 and RS-485 communication with RUNZE, MODBUS and ASCII protocols. External-drive versions provide optocoupler home-position sensing for OEM controller integration.

Dual 10-32 UNF Syringe wash ports can be connected to a cleaning circuit to help remove deposits from the ceramic Syringe surface. The transparent PCTG pump head allows visual inspection of the fluid path during setup and maintenance.


Key Features

• Volume error <=1% at rated stroke.

• Repeatability error of 0.3%-0.7% at rated stroke.

• 100, 500 and 1000 uL capacity options.

• Minimum dispense resolution from 0.025 uL, depending on capacity and lead-screw pitch.

• Dual Syringe wash ports help reduce crystal build-up and maintenance frequency.

• PCTG, alumina ceramic, UPE and FKM wetted materials.

• RS-232 and RS-485 communication on integrated-driver versions.

• RUNZE, MODBUS and ASCII control protocols.

• Tested for 3,000,000 cycles without leakage using pure water at one rated stroke per cycle.


Technical Specifications

• Nominal volume: 100 uL / 500 uL / 1000 uL

• Back pressure: 0.5 MPa

• Rated stroke: 12.7 mm

• Maximum rotation speed: 300 rpm

• Maximum Syringe drive force: >=100 N

• Fluid port: 1/4-28 UNF female

• Syringe wash port: 10-32 UNF

• Communication: RS-232 / RS-485

• Baud rates: 9600 / 19200 / 38400 / 57600 / 115200 bps

• Power supply: 24 VDC / 3 A for the integrated-driver version

• Operating temperature: 5-55 C

• Relative humidity: <=80% RH, non-condensing

• Size with driver: approximately 44.5 x 62.3 x 153 mm

• Size without driver: approximately 44.5 x 62.3 x 133.4 mm

• Weight: approximately 0.46 kg with driver / 0.42 kg without driver


Applications

• Laboratory and analytical instruments

• Online water-quality monitoring systems

• Biochemical, blood, electrolyte and trace-element analyzers

• Chromatographic and petroleum-testing instruments

• Reagent sampling and micro-dosing modules

• Automated filling and dispensing equipment

• Custom OEM fluid-handling systems

Application Note of Pre-torque Flangeless Fittings

1. Choose 1/4-28 nut when receiving port is 1/4-28; Choose M6 nut when receiving port is M6.


2. Before connecting fittings, ensure the end of the tubing has a clean, square, burr-free cut. This is very important, as the square cut helps the tubing make full contact with the bottom of the mating port. Neglecting to properly cut the tubing could lead to dead volume, resulting in peak distortion such as fronting, tailing or broadening.


3. Two-Piece Fittings Installation Steps:

a. Slide the nut, followed by the ferrule, at least 3/16” (4.7625mm) from the end of the clean cut tubing

b. Insert the assembly into the receiving port, pushing the tubing into the port until it bottoms out.

c. Finger or wrench tighten the fittings until the cap comes out "click" which means properly tightened

d. After several uses (especially at high pressure) the ferrule should be replaced.

title: PFA Tube - Nanjing Runze Fluid Control Equipment Co., LTD.
desc: RUNZE PFA tube is fully transparent rigid fluoropolymer tubing designed for high-purity and chemically demanding fluid paths. The combination of chemical resistance, broad continuous-use temperature range and controlled inner and outer diameters makes it suitable for transferring reagents, samples, ultrapure water and process chemicals in analytical and industrial fluid systems.
bodyHtml:

• Fully transparent PFA material for visual inspection of the fluid path.

• Continuous-use temperature range from -100°C to +260°C.

• Shore D hardness of 60.

• Chemical resistance for use with many strong acids, strong alkalis and organic solvents.

• Nineteen standard ID/OD combinations for different flow and connection requirements.

• ID and OD tolerances of ±0.05 mm or ±0.15 mm, depending on size.

• Flanging service available for selected tube sizes.

• Compatible with matching RUNZE rigid-tube fittings.

Applications of PFA Tubing

• High-purity chemical delivery systems

• Semiconductor and photovoltaic process equipment

• Ultrapure-water and water-treatment systems

• Laboratory and analytical instruments

• Reagent and sample fluid transfer

• Chemical-processing and industrial fluid-control systems

• Fluid paths used with syringe pumps, valves and rigid-tube fittings


PFA Tube Selection Notes

• Select the inner diameter according to the required flow rate and internal volume.

• Match the outer diameter to the receiving fitting and connection method.

• Confirm fluid compatibility using the actual chemical, concentration, temperature and exposure time.

• Confirm the allowable pressure for the selected tube size, temperature and fitting arrangement.

• Specify whether flanging service is required when requesting a quotation.

• Provide the required tube length or packaging format with the selected SKU or model number.


Frequently Asked Questions

What is PFA tube used for?

PFA tube is used for transferring high-purity or chemically demanding fluids in semiconductor, ultrapure-water, laboratory, chemical-processing and analytical systems.

What is the continuous-use temperature range?

The stated continuous-use temperature range is -100°C to +260°C.

Which PFA tube sizes are available?

RUNZE offers 19 standard ID/OD combinations from 0.5 x 1.6 mm to 8.0 x 10.0 mm.

Is the tubing transparent?

Yes. The listed RUNZE PFA tubing is fully transparent for easier visual inspection of the fluid path.

Can RUNZE provide flanged PFA tubing?

Flanging service is available for the models marked Yes in the specification table.

How should I choose a PFA tube model?

Provide the required ID, OD, fluid, concentration, operating temperature, pressure, length and connection method so the matching model and fitting can be confirmed.
